I'm Suraj, and before I spent a rupee on applications, I sent the same message to five people from my college who work in Melbourne: 'Can I ask you three honest questions for fifteen minutes?' Four said yes. Nitin, who graduated two years before me, called the same night.

Rent was nearly double what the brochure showed. Two had taken over six months to find work in their field. Nitin said the loneliness hit in month three and stayed until he joined a cricket club.
I'm still going. But I'm going with a budget and a plan for month three.
